title: Dark form controls: custom Select instead of native dropdowns, cleaner inputs
brief:
Desktop app (React 19 + TS + Tailwind v4 + lucide-react, folder desktop/), simple black Smurf shell in desktop/src/smurf/ (read theme.css first). Problem: native <select> dropdowns glitch in the Windows WebView (light popup list on a black app, wrong position), and inputs look unfinished.
1. theme.css: add `color-scheme: dark` on :root; make .sm-input height 32px, padding 0 10px, font-size 13px, border 1px solid var(--line), background var(--panel), placeholder color #5b5b63, hover border-color #3f3f46, focus border-color #71717a plus box-shadow 0 0 0 3px rgba(113,113,122,.25) (keep the existing :focus-visible outline for buttons); textarea.sm-input: height auto, padding 8px 10px, line-height 1.5, resize vertical; input[type=checkbox]: accent-color var(--text), 14px. Dark thin scrollbars for the whole app (::-webkit-scrollbar 8px, thumb #2a2a2e radius 8, track transparent). Add .sm-menu (background var(--raised), border 1px solid var(--line), radius 8px, box-shadow 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.5), padding 4px) and .sm-menu-item (height 30px, padding 0 10px, radius 6px, cursor pointer; hover/active background #232327; selected: color var(--text) with a check icon; others var(--muted)).
2. ui/Select.tsx: export `Select<T extends string>({ value, options, onChange, placeholder?, disabled?, size? ('md'|'sm'), ariaLabel?, className? })` with options `{ value: T; label: string; hint?: string; disabled?: boolean }[]`. Renders a button styled like .sm-input (sm = height 26px, 12px text, used as compact chips) showing the selected label (or muted placeholder) and a ChevronDown; clicking opens a .sm-menu listbox directly under the button (position absolute inside a relative wrapper, min-width = button width, max-height 280px, overflow auto, z-index 50; open upward when there is not enough room below: measure with getBoundingClientRect against window.innerHeight). Each option is a .sm-menu-item with label and optional muted hint on the right. Keyboard: Enter/Space/ArrowDown opens; ArrowUp/ArrowDown move the active item (skip disabled), Enter selects, Escape closes and returns focus to the button, Tab closes; typing a letter jumps to the next option starting with it. Closes on outside mousedown. ARIA: button aria-haspopup='listbox' aria-expanded; list role='listbox'; items role='option' aria-selected. No portal, no extra dependency.
3. ui/Select.test.tsx (vitest + @testing-library/react if it is already a devDependency, otherwise test an exported pure helper `nextIndex(options, from, step)` that skips disabled options and wraps): opening, keyboard selection, disabled skip, Escape.
4. ui/Field.tsx: `Field({ label, htmlFor?, help?, error?, children })`: label above (12px, var(--text), weight 500), children, then help (11px var(--muted)) or error (11px var(--bad), role='alert').
5. Replace EVERY native <select> in desktop/src/smurf/RunsView.tsx, SettingsView.tsx, WorkflowsView.tsx and canvas/NodePanel.tsx with <Select>, and wrap labelled inputs there in <Field> where a label exists today. Keep behaviour identical otherwise; do not restructure those screens.

title: Runs like n8n: live edges, node badges, click a node or agent for its terminal and changes, bottom-center task composer
brief:
Desktop app (React 19 + TS + Tailwind v4 + @xyflow/react 12 + lucide-react, folder desktop/), simple black Smurf shell in desktop/src/smurf/. Read theme.css, ui/Select.tsx, ui/Field.tsx, RunsView.tsx, runs/runApi.ts, runs/AgentTerminal.tsx, canvas/FlowCanvas.tsx, canvas/NodeCard.tsx, canvas/AgentNode.tsx, canvas/graph.ts first. Goal: the Runs screen should feel like n8n while a run executes. Keep FlowCanvas's performance rules (module-level nodeTypes, apply all xyflow changes, update node/edge data with setNodes/setEdges maps instead of rebuilding).
Server: GET /api/runs/:runId/agents/:agentId/diff -> { diff: string; files: { path: string; status: string }[] } (worker agents only; empty for others). Everything else as already used in runApi.ts.
1. canvas/graph.ts: pure `edgeState(from?: string, to?: string): 'done'|'active'|'idle'` from the two node statuses ('completed'|'running'|'waiting'|'pending'|undefined): active when from is completed and to is running or waiting; done when both are completed; else idle. Tests in graph.test.ts (keep existing tests).
2. FlowCanvas.tsx: when `status` is given, style graph edges by edgeState (update only edge data/style via setEdges map): done = stroke var(--ok) 2px; active = stroke var(--run) 2px with `animated: true` (xyflow's moving dashes); idle = stroke #3f3f46 1.5px. Unchanged without status.
3. NodeCard.tsx: a 18px round badge at the top-right corner by data.status, with icon AND color (never color only): completed = Check on var(--ok); running = a spinning Loader2 on var(--run) (spin disabled by the reduced-motion rule); waiting = Pause on var(--wait); pending = none. Keep the existing ring.
4. runs/runApi.ts: add `fetchDiff(runId, agentId)` (fallback { diff: '', files: [] }) + a test.
5. runs/AgentTerminal.tsx: add two tabs under the header: 'Terminal' (the current view) and 'Changes' (only for kind 'worker'): fetchDiff on open/agent change and again when the agent stops being live; list changed files (status letter + path, .mono 12px), then the diff in a <pre> where lines starting with '+' are var(--ok), '-' var(--bad), '@@' var(--run), others #a1a1aa; 'No changes' when empty.
6. runs/NodeInspector.tsx: right panel (same 420px slot as AgentTerminal) shown when a WORKFLOW node is clicked in the run canvas: node name + type, its status badge, the spec description (from the node specs RunsView already loads), and the list of agents anchored to that node, newest first (icon by kind, title, model, status in tone color, a live dot); clicking an agent switches the panel to its AgentTerminal (with a small Back link to the node). Empty list: muted 'No agents ran on this step yet'.
7. runs/Composer.tsx: n8n-style floating composer, absolutely positioned at the bottom center OVER the run canvas (bottom 20px, width min(720px, calc(100% - 48px)), background var(--raised), 1px border var(--line), radius 14px, box-shadow 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55), padding 10px 12px). Row 1: auto-growing <textarea> (1 to 6 rows, no border, transparent, 14px) with placeholder 'Give the team a task…' (or 'Answer the senior…' when the run asks a question). Row 2: compact <Select size='sm'> chips for workflow and senior (only when starting a new run), a muted hint 'Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line', and on the right a round 32px send button (ArrowUp icon, .sm-btn-primary colors; disabled when empty or busy; shows a spinner while sending). When the run is live and not waiting, the send button becomes a Stop button (Square icon) that sends stop_run. When state.waiting has options, show them as a row of pill buttons just above the composer box (the existing decision buttons move here). Props: { mode: 'new'|'answer'|'live'|'idle', workflows, seniors, waiting, onStart(text, workflowId, senior), onAnswer(text), onDecision(option), onStop() }.
8. RunsView.tsx: replace the separate 'New run' form screen with the composer: 'New run' just clears the selected run and focuses the composer; with no run selected the canvas shows the chosen workflow (read-only, no status) behind the composer. Starting uses the existing create session -> set senior -> send flow and then selects the new run. Run list rows also show the workflow id (muted) and, while live, a small pulsing dot. Clicking a workflow node opens NodeInspector, clicking an agent node opens AgentTerminal, clicking the pane closes the panel. Keep the Messages/Log area but make it a collapsible drawer under the canvas (collapsed by default, a thin bar 'Messages · Log' to open it) so the canvas and composer get the space. Keep everything else working.
